The Art of ordinary days ✨💭

Golden October at home. 🍂
Made a last-minute trip up to the Black Forest for sunset tonight, and it was absolutely worth it. The city down in the valley had been covered in fog all day, but I had a feeling the light might break through higher up. I got there just in time for the last ten minutes of good light. These are the moments I love searching for the most: fleeting conditions that you can rarely plan for and almost never get twice. Tonight it was that short window right before sunset, when the light came through the fog between the trees and created this incredible atmosphere.

📍 Black Forest, Germany

@goproanz have taken the MISSION 1 PRO ILS to a whole new level 🎥

Being able to run proper Micro Four Thirds glass on a GoPro, while still having something this small and rugged, opens up so many possibilities. I can throw it into some of the craziest scenarios, keep the setup super lightweight and pocket-sized, but still come away with footage that is so cinematic.

I’ve been shooting a lot of 4K 240fps for insane slow motion, and 8K 60fps when I want that extra resolution. Add GP-Log 2 into the mix and the image coming out of this setup is out of this world!

Been a bit M.I.A
A little life update, I guess.

This past year has been one of the more challenging years of my life, both personally and creatively.

It’s been a strange one. On the outside, it probably looks like I’ve been pretty quiet, and truthfully, I have. Not a whole lot of posting, not much passion work, and a lot of projects sitting behind embargoes.

But behind the scenes, there’s been a huge amount of growth. We’ve spent so much of this year building @auteurstudios, learning, putting systems in place, creating processes and laying foundations for what we want to create in the future. It’s the kind of growth that isn’t sexy and exciting to share, but something I’m proud of.

On a personal level too, losing my Nana was one of the hardest things I’ve experienced. She was someone I always considered a muse of mine. Losing her left a hole that I don’t think will ever completely disappear.

And somewhere amongst all of this, I feel like I’ve lost a little bit of that creative spark. That feeling of picking up a camera simply because I love creating. Hence why I’ve picked up drawing and painting again. 

I’ve also taken a pretty big step back from Instagram. Barely posting, checking messages or even scrolling. And while that’s actually been incredibly refreshing for my mental health, I do miss the community this platform gave me. The friendships, opportunities and inspiration that have come from sharing my work here are things I’ll always be grateful for.

So I’ve been thinking about how I want to use this Instagram moving forward.

I still love creating cinematic work, and that’ll always be at the heart of what I do. But I also want to share more of the journey. The behind-the-scenes moments, the travels, the people, the little things that don’t necessarily make it into a finished film. A little less always so polished. 

I genuinely believe this period of growth, even with all its challenges, is setting the foundations for something really special. And I’m excited to get back to creating for the pure love of it.
Plenty more to come. 🤍

Die Katze ist aus dem Sack 👀

Okay, das mit dem Geheimhalten hat nur so semi gut funktioniert! 😬 Aber hey, dann können wir euch jetzt endlich richtig mit auf unsere Journey nehmen:

THE CREATORS geht in die 2. Staffel und wir sind auf der wunderschönen Insel @usedom! ⚓️

Mit dabei sind wieder sechs großartige Creator aus dem DACH-Raum: @felix_heinzelmann, @hannahassil, @julievalentina, @justmabo, @luukepk und unser Wildcard-Gewinner @bewegtbild_manufaktur_.

@dennisschmelz führt als Initiator, Host und Produzent durch die neue Staffel. Und damit ihr noch mehr von dem mitbekommt, was hinter den Kulissen passiert, ist @mikesuminski für BTS-Fotos und -Videos mit am Start.

Produziert wird THE CREATORS Staffel 2 gemeinsam mit @gecko.1.films, die auch dieses Jahr wieder dafür sorgen, dass aus all dem kreativen Chaos am Ende eine Serie wird. 

Die ersten zwei Challenges sind bereits gespielt und es ist ein Kopf-an-Kopf-Rennen.

Schon diesen Freitag gegen 13:30 Uhr wartet das nächste Community Voting auf euch. Dieses Mal seid ihr wieder ein Teil der Entscheidung.

Ein riesiges Danke an unseren Destination Partner @usedom und unsere großartigen Gastgeber @boje06usedom & @strandhotelostseeblick. Danke für die herzliche Gastfreundschaft, wir freuen uns riesig die neue Staffel bei euch im hohen Norden drehen zu dürfen! 🫶

Freut euch auf alles was noch kommt und abonniert uns auch auf YouTube, um nichts mehr zu verpassen. Staffel 2 wird voraussichtlich im März 2027 ausgestrahlt! 🎬

More than 20 years in between, same spot. 🇮🇹
For me, Lago di Braies is still one of the prettiest lakes in the Dolomites. But what’s different is the huge amount of people. Parking, crowds, queues for the boats, it’s a completely different place today than it was back in the days when we shot the old picture with my sister and myself.
My sister couldn’t make it this time, I guess we have to come back together one day and take this picture one more time with both of us in it.
